llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must derive an explicit dirty state for the edit form (for example comparing current input vs last saved value) and only block leaving when that state is dirty.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Dirty state is explicitly derived by comparing `name` (current input) with `savedName` (last saved value): `const hasUnsavedChanges = name !== savedName`.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must intercept native-stack back/remove actions with `usePreventRemove(...)` on the edit screen.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: `usePreventRemove` is imported from `@react-navigation/native` and called inside `EditScreen` with `hasUnsavedChanges` as the guard condition.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must show an explicit confirmation choice when leaving with unsaved changes and resume on confirm (for example by dispatching `data.action`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: An `Alert.alert` confirmation dialog is shown when leaving with unsaved changes; pressing 'Discard' dispatches `data.action` to resume the navigation action.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must allow leaving the edit screen without a confirmation prompt when there are no unsaved changes.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: `usePreventRemove` is passed `hasUnsavedChanges` which is `false` when `name === savedName`, so no interception occurs and the user can leave freely when there are no unsaved changes.
